notes.title: I KNOW YOUR ADDRESS v1.0.1
notes.content:
HELLO ADRESS KNOWERS,

Been a while, huh? This update is focused on various small changes and bug fixes, such as there now being an option to skip the intro, more visuals being added to the Extreme Fractions ending, and the shopkeeper being made less monotonous to click in Leonardo DeClickrio.

A large content update is planned and I was going to publish these changes with the larger update, but I decided to do this instead so I could have it out before the Steam sale. I did this mostly since there's a bit of people having trouble with the intro, so I wanted to make it easier and allow people to skip so people didn't quit before getting to the rest of the game. On release of the next update, there will be several announcements relating to "Blinko Gamehouse," so check the announcements page when it's out... if you dare...

Additionally, if you wish to play V1.0, you may do so by finding the game in your library-->right clicking and selecting properties-->clicking on the "betas" tab on the side of the pop up window-->selecting V1.0 under beta participation.

Until next time.

[h2][b]CHANGE NOTES:[/b][/h2]
[b][h3]MINOR CHANGES & BUG FIXES:[/h3][/b]
[b]Title and Intro:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the "Hide UI" button on the options menu where the lyrics would reappear after the song looped, even when the UI should be hidden.
[*]Made the platforming segment in the intro much easier
[*]Option now available to skip intro at the beginning of the game. If you use this option, you will be automatically put into the route of the game where you do not do the intro's platforming section.
[*]Text will now appear in the platforming section of the intro that lets the player know if they fall from a tall height, dying will bring them back to their last checkpoint.
[*]There is now a custom icon for the game window and application. I couldn't find out how to get this to work on release.
[/list]

[b]Leonardo DeClickrio:[/b]
[list]
[*]Clicking the shopkeeper now makes him switch between 3 new expressions
[*]The clown horn sound effect that plays when the shopkeeper is clicked now plays a random pitch between 80%-120% to make the sound effect less repetitive.
[*]Brightness increases when hovering over the shopkeeper now. Basically all of these changes makes clicking the shopkeeper slightly more entertaining. Not too entertaining though. I mean, you are clicking a png 1,000 times for a virtual medal.
[/list]

[b]Escape Joe Biden:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug in Escape Joe Biden where, if you hit the max number of collectables during a round (5 paintings, etc.), another could spawn during only that same round if you survive long enough.
[/list]

[b]Extreme Fractions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a stray transparent pixel on the teeth of the math witch in the break room.
[*]Changed a texture of a [spoiler]floor in the 3d section of Extreme Fractions[/spoiler] from stretched to tiled
[*]The following decorations were added to the [spoiler]3D section of Extreme Fractions[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]Silly posters.[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]Silly clocks.[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]Silly windows.[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]Chalkboards. The silly kind. [/spoiler]
[*] -In the final section of Extreme Fractions, the subtitles now have an outline for better readability.
[/list]

Here is my favorite decoration from the new update: [spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834032/dfcf55b89af4154b6632cb5df7a670fb7341931e.png[/img][/spoiler]. I think it's pretty funny.

[b]Office Simulator:[/b]
[list]
[*]The window to avoid being caught by security cameras has been changed from 0.2 seconds to 0.4 seconds
[*]Increased movement speed of the player character slightly and adjusted the camera zoom.
[*]Fixed one security camera right to the entrance on level 2 in which one of parts of its view was displaced a couple pixels too far to the left and was overlapping with the wall.
[/list]

[b]Ending:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the volume of the music during the ending. The first half was noticeably quieter than other parts of the game.
[/list]
